resolvedQuestions.text: Does it cover official Designer and Bridge App semantics deeply enough for reliable execution?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Bridge architecture is correct, but execution semantics are materially incomplete.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does it cover content, publishing, branches, scripts, forms, localization, assets, webhooks, and enterprise behavior deeply enough?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Coverage breadth is high, but lifecycle constraints and endpoint limits are materially incomplete.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does the local packet accurately and sufficiently describe its own tool inventory, safety boundaries, payloads, and local-versus-remote reconciliation?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Broad inventory, but payload, effect, version, and reconciliation defects prevent reliable execution.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does it cover AI tools, agent instructions, WHTML, utility tools, rate limits, and local-versus-remote differences without overclaiming?
resolvedQuestions.answer: No; one P0 trust gap and multiple P1/P2 workflow gaps remain.

resolvedQuestions.text: Do feature cards and manual scenarios trace to important official behavior and edge cases?
resolvedQuestions.answer: They cover broad operation classes but contain factual errors and omit most capability-specific invariants and advanced failures.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treat the packet as uniformly too concise
ruledOutDirections.reason: The action inventory is broad; executable semantics are the actual gap.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Assume all Designer operations require the Bridge App
ruledOutDirections.reason: Only live canvas/session state and snapshots require it.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Assume remote CMS create/update writes are immediately live
ruledOutDirections.reason: Remote create/update actions produce drafts and publish separately.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treat local OSS and remote as transport variants of one contract
ruledOutDirections.reason: Migration changes tool names, locations, inputs, Bridge requirements, and behavior.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treat 17 scenarios as comprehensive MCP 2.0 coverage
ruledOutDirections.reason: Operation-class coverage omits most capability-specific invariants and advanced failures.
